title: Latitudes
meta_description: Find the perfect Destin, FL vacation rental at “Latitudes”, a Gulf Front luxury 7-bed, 6-bath vacation rental. Ideal for 18 guests, this home offers Private Pool, Carriage House, Game Room & Golf Cart for your enjoyment. Book your stay now!
description_expanded: Home Highlights - Gulf Front Home with Private Beach Access - Private Pool (Pool can be heated for an additional $50 per day from October 1 - May 1) -3 Complimentary beach setups include 6 chairs and 3 umbrella - Service provided Mar 1-Oct 31 - Completely Remodeled Interior - 6 Adult Bikes Included - 6 seater Golf Cart Included - Carriage House w/ Game Room In search of new Latitudes for your next luxury getaway, it’s all in the name. Latitudes is a magnificent Gulf Front vacation rental in the heart of Crystal Beach. Centrally located, Latitudes is near the most desirable shopping, elite golf courses, and decadent coastal cuisine. Pristine gulf views encompass this expansive seven bedroom and seven and a half bath retreat. Sleeping 18 guests, Latitudes is elegantly furnished and delicately finished with modern coastal touches. Latitudes is the perfect beachfront estate, complete with an adjacent and separated carriage house with its own kitchen allowing privacy among families. Floor-to-ceiling windows define the indoor/outdoor living philosophy, encouraging plenty of indoor lounging or playful outdoor activities around the private pool overlooking the rolling waves. Enjoy conversations on lush furnishings in the open gathering space or be thrilled watching the latest sports event on the large flat screen television. Prepare culinary delights in the spacious kitchen or hire a private chef to serve local delicacies in the airy dining room. The oversized kitchen island serves as a centralized congregation area; perfect for wine tasting, charcuterie, or the chef’s chosen amuse-bouche. The bedrooms are just as inviting with all the luxury necessities needed for a peaceful night’s sleep. The master suite is extraordinary, with a king bed, flat screen tv, endless gulf views and direct access to a private balcony with seating perfect for sunsets. Guest suites are equally exquisite with comfortable mattresses and cozy bedding. The kids will enjoy their own private fun-zone in the bunk room with a twin bunk and one single. On the second level of the adjacent carriage house is an additional guest suite with a queen bed and en-suite bath. The bottom floor of the carriage house is reserved for friendly competitions, with a pool table and foosball table. Plunge into the secluded pool after a warm beach day or walk down the private boardwalk to the crushed quartz sand of the gulf. Or just simply appreciate the rolling tranquil turquoise waters which will enhance the senses and relax perspectives. Enjoy excellent golfing nearby with four courses to choose from within the Sandestin Golf and Beach Resort. Or splurge in designer goods from the Destin Commons or the Market Shops at Sandestin. Triumphantly finish the day with an extraordinary meal at The Henderson, Ruth’s Chris Steak House, or Soleil! The property includes on-site parking for up to 8 vehicles. Sleeping Arrangement First Floor King Bedroom w/ Private Bathroom, Shower Only Second Floor King Master Bedroom with Private Bathroom, Shower & Tub separate King Jr Master Bedroom with Private Bathroom, Shower Only King Bedroom with Private Bathroom, Shower Only Double Queen Bedroom with Private Bathroom, Shower Only Bunk Room, Twin/Twin and Single Twin, Shared Bathroom Shower Only Carriage House First Floor Game Room with Twin/Twin Bunk Sleeper Sofa Second Floor Queen Bedroom with Shower Only
